reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_services_unsatisfied`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Metric collection configurations that reference `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` will not receive the renamed metric; monitoring dashboards and alerting rules using the old metric name will stop functioning.

proposed.statement: The metric `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_services_unsatisfied`.
